evidence.title: GitHub - rizznme/cosmic-ui: A collection of Sci-Fi themed components and futuristic design elements for modern web applications.
Cosmic UI - Sci-Fi UI Components for React and Vue

name: Cosmic UI
summary: Sci-fi themed React and Vue UI component library with HUD-styled frames, glowing borders and futuristic elements.
description: Copy-paste component library of futuristic, sci-fi styled UI: buttons, dialogs, menus, tabs, toasts, form controls, tables, charts and a custom SVG Frame decoration system. Documented on cosmic-ui.com with live previews and per-component install commands; built with Zag.js state machines, Tailwind CSS and TypeScript, with React and Vue versions.
contains: 27 sci-fi styled components incl. Frame, Alert, Dialog, Tabs, Toast, Chart, Table, Sheet, Datepicker
React and Vue versions with per-component copy/install commands
custom SVG Frame decoration system for angular HUD styling
docs site with live previews at cosmic-ui.com
